The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''3962 before the Battle of Yavin (BBY)''', also known as '''309 before the Treaty of Coruscant''', '''2,962 before the Ruusan Reformation''' and '''3,927 before the Great ReSynchronization''', was a standard year during the [[Mandalorian Wars]].

==History==
During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] 3962 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] advanced from their empire carved out in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] towards the inner [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions. With a two-pronged assault called [[Mandalorian Triumph]], they fought their way to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], taking a number of [[Planet/Legends|planets]] before achieving their goal of conquering [[Duro/Legends|Duro]].<ref name="Atlas" />
